name: @pipeworx/mcp-gnews

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search global news articles by keyword (e.g., "climate change", "AI regulation"). Returns title, description, content snippet, source, and publication date. Supports language and country filters.

tools.name: top_headlines
tools.description: Fetch current top news headlines from GNews (requires BYO API key). Optionally filter by category (general, world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health), country code, and language. Returns up to 100 articles with title, description, source, and publication date.

category.description: News category: general, world, nation, business, technology, entertainment, sports, science, health

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gnews forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gnews pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
